extract_feat_PointmapEstimator: extract features from input images using the backbone and optional neck modules
encode_decode_PointmapEstimator: encode images with backbone and decode into a depth map of the same size as input
loss_PointmapEstimator: calculate losses from a batch of inputs and data samples for training
predict_PointmapEstimator: predict depth estimation results from a batch of inputs with post-processing
inference_PointmapEstimator: run inference with slide whole or slide flip mode to produce depth estimation results
